title: bidens tripartita f. orthodoxa
intro: Bidens tripartita f. orthodoxa, commonly known as St. Johnswort's cousin, is a plant species that belongs to the Asteraceae family. It is known for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation, improve mental clarity, and exhibit antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Bidens tripartita f. orthodoxa include its use as an anti-inflammatory agent, an antioxidant, and a potential treatment for anxiety and depression. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenes, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
